provenance.pilot_area: Camarines Sur Pilot Farming Cluster (Bicol River Basin)
datasets_used: Sentinel-1 (ESA/Copernicus C-Band SAR VV/VH) — RTC, orbit 134, 2024-10-09 vs 2024-10-21
NASA POWER (Daily PRECTOTCORR Rainfall — 510 mm antecedent + event)
Landsat 8-9 / MODIS NDVI — pending (feature/rotation-engine; bare-field days are placeholders)
provenance.scientific_limit: Surface wetness layers are derived from C-band Sentinel-1 SAR backscatter, not direct root-zone soil moisture measurements. C-band cannot see standing water between buildings (double-bounce brightens instead of darkening), so built-up cells show no flood signal.
provenance.sar_hit_rate_note: sar_hit_rate = share of SAR-flooded 30 m cells in the pilot bbox that the full risk map rated high. It shares ΔVV with the flood mask, so it is a consistency check. sar_hit_rate_terrain_only uses a model without SAR (terrain + rain) and is the independent test. sar_hit_rate_plots uses whole-plot classes (CLAUDE.md §3D.3). All are n/a when the SAR flood mask is empty.

risk_class_thresholds.missing: no valid SAR pixel (flagged, not scored)

rainfall.source: NASA POWER daily PRECTOTCORR (point query at map centre)

rotation_strategies.name: Nitrogen-Fixing & Soil Restorative Rotation
rotation_strategies.mechanics: Integrates deep-rooted legumes during post-harvest bare-field windows identified via multi-year NDVI.
rotation_strategies.benefits: Restores soil organic matter, fixes atmospheric N2 to cut synthetic fertilizer purchases, and breaks root-knot nematode pest cycles.
rotation_strategies.risks_and_gaps: Verify local mungbean/cowpea seed supply and check plot soil pH compatibility with Municipal Agriculture Office.

rotation_strategies.name: Deep-Rooting & Erosion Control Cover Crop (Bio-Tillage)
rotation_strategies.mechanics: Plants deep-rooting brassicas or grasses across NASADEM high-velocity micro-slope runoff channels.
rotation_strategies.benefits: Creates sub-surface macro-pores that accelerate water infiltration, relieve surface ponding, and anchor topsoil against heavy rain.
rotation_strategies.risks_and_gaps: Evaluate local labor or forage harvesting equipment requirements before planting.

rotation_strategies.name: Water-Conserving & Heat-Tolerant Short-Cycle Rotation
rotation_strategies.mechanics: Transitions water-intensive cereal crops during dry windows to short-cycle, low-water-demand grains.
rotation_strategies.benefits: Lowers seasonal irrigation demand while avoiding flowering-stage heat stress and diversifying household cash income.
rotation_strategies.risks_and_gaps: Review local buyer demand and farmgate price stability with extension officers.
